core.attribution: Core changes include both prerequisite branches. Registry.parseAsync settlement is inherited from the async prerequisite; harness-only thunk and hook changes are opt-in.

gateResults.nodeContracts: passed; 8 runtime scenarios plus report reconciliation

measurementCommands.buildMain: go build -p 2 -o /tmp/harness-async/main-abapiti ./cmd/abapiti (from git archive of the recorded origin/main SHA)

defaultComparison.reason: The harness parent unconditionally includes an unused string.repeat helper. No other generated source, ABAP output, archive or site metadata differs. The emission-only fix is prepared separately and awaits an exception to the reserved repeat scope.

fixedRoots: Promise-returning parameterless test callbacks, including synchronous callbacks returning Promise values
Go host drains returned settled promises before counting pass and preserves rejection messages
Pending/uncertified promises and arbitrary thenables are async-pending, never pass
Async before/beforeEach/afterEach/after hooks, suite lifetime, setup-failure replay and context binding
Deferred owned mocha callbacks no longer poison module initialization merely by reading class statics

remaining.reason: The existing settlement proof cannot certify these producers, including virtual Registry.parseAsync calls through local receivers. They remain async-pending; no scheduler is invented.
All reach existing traps; principally Config.getDefault JSON round trip and downport JSON/conf702 lowering. No original async candidate is reported as a pass.

Merged prerequisite object-array typing makes module initialization fail verification in definitions_top (5), obsolete_statement (4), and unnecessary_pragma (7): expected array<test-row shape>, got array<builtin.object>. Object literal/type ABI is reserved for another owner.
Registration/module initialization still fails on shapes, dynamic forEach and unsupported regexp, among other recorded diagnostics.
Remaining compiler categories are recorded by exact message; 325 HIR verification errors also remain. These are not claimed fixed by the harness integration.
